mentions.name: SynDiary
mentions.description: SynDiary is a private personal data hub that brings scattered parts of a user's digital life together into one place, helps make sense of the data, and turns selected data into meaningful personal Projects. The free core consolidates data, including a Calendar feature with export, import, and synchronization, with everything kept on the user's device so they stay in control. Upcoming features include Projects for making data meaningful and Editions for experiencing, preserving, and sharing data.
mentions.problem: People's digital life data is scattered across many places and hard to bring together, understand, and put to meaningful use.
mentions.audience: Personal use — individuals consolidating and controlling their own digital life data on their device.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're working on SynDiary app. This is a private personal data hub that helps you bring scattered parts of your digital life and more together into one place, understand it and turn selected data into meaningful personal Projects. You are in control, all on our device.
